name: SANUWAVE Health, Inc.
business_overview: SANUWAVE Health, Inc. operates as a medical device company in the United States and internationally. It focuses on the commercialization of regenerative medicines through noninvasive ultrasound or shockwaves to produce a biological response promoting the repair and regeneration of tissue, musculoskeletal, and vascular structures. The company markets UltraMist system, a medical device that uses non-thermal ultrasound to treat tissues using a fluid mist to transmit energy in a non-contact and pain free way for use in the treatment of acute and chronic wounds. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Medical device company commercializing noninvasive ultrasound for wound healing.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** SANUWAVE is capitalizing on strong demand for its UltraMIST wound care system, achieving record levels of activity as it expands device placements and sales coverage. The company appears to be exploiting industry disruption to gain market share in advanced wound care. While the business sustained solid growth, the latest quarter saw a slower pace, hinting at lumpy deal closure, but the broader adoption trend remains intact.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership has successfully guided the company to operating profitability and continues to scale the commercial organization. Yet, the investment narrative is resetting after an analyst price-target cut and notable insider selling, which weigh on sentiment alongside a negative equity cushion. Management projects reaccelerating growth ahead, but market confidence is now measured against these execution and balance-sheet concerns.

# Sanuwave Announces Record Revenues and Financial Results for Q4 and Full Year 2025

March 26, 2026 17:00 ET | Source: SANUWAVE Health, Inc. Follow SANUWAVE Health, Inc.

Eden Prairie, MN

---

Share

---

Q4 2025 revenues were $13.4 million, up 29.7% from Q4 2024. This was an all-time quarterly record for the Company.

Full year 2025 revenues were $44.1 million up 35.0% from full year 2024 revenues. This was an all-time annual record for the Company.

Q4 2025 gross margin was 74.7%, versus 77.9% in Q4 2024 and 77.6% in Q3 2025.

Full year 2025 gross margin was 77.1% versus 75.2% in 2024.

GAAP Operating Income was $2.0 million for Q4 2025 and $4.9 million for full year 2025.

Company provides guidance for revenues of $9.6-10.3 million (an increase of 3-10%) for Q1 2026 as compared to Q1 2025 and initiates full year 2026 revenue guidance of 16-25% growth vs 2025 ($51.0-55.0 million).

EDEN PRAIRIE, Minn., March 26, 2026
